headline: Lānaʻi Planning Commission Approves STR & AT&T Permit Extensions

meeting.body: Lānaʻi Planning Commission Approves STR & AT&T Permit Extensions
meeting.summary: The Lānaʻi Planning Commission approved a five-year short-term rental permit extension and an AT&T permit extension, and heard updates on minor permit rules.
meeting.recap: The Lānaʻi Planning Commission met on October 21, 2026.[[0:00:30]] Commissioners first considered a five-year extension of a three-bedroom short-term rental permit at 303 Caldwell Avenue.[[0:02:50]] The Planning Department recommended approval, subject to 22 conditions.[[0:05:15]] Staff said Lānaʻi has eight permitted short-term rentals and can have up to 15.[[0:13:18]] The commission voted unanimously to approve the five-year extension.[[0:22:53]] AT&T Mobility asked for a time extension on a county special use permit for a telecommunications facility.[[0:23:24]] The chair asked why some documents listed a different street address for the site.[[0:25:19]] A landowner representative said the county tax office uses a different address than the county's official address of record.[[0:32:11]] The commission voted unanimously to approve the AT&T extension.[[0:37:41]] Staff said the public has two weeks from this meeting to appeal permits on the completed applications report.[[0:41:42]] A commissioner raised community concerns about lighting at a recent event approved with a minor permit.[[0:45:00]] Staff said permit holders must follow the night sky lighting ordinance.[[0:46:14]] Staff said changes to the commission's minor permit rules are on about step 13 of 15.[[0:50:08]] A commissioner asked that the Planning Director attend next month's meeting.[[0:53:31]]
meeting.next: No agenda items are scheduled yet for the next meeting. Staff will email the chair a list of what remains to be done on the rule change.
